recommended_path: Preserve the approved architecture and Web152 source repairs. The case-specific account identities, UUID-bound text oracle and mounted/current-ticket checks address the reported source defects. Complete the new unmount regression's application-consumption barrier under existing IG-ADHERENCE111D-04, then obtain current native browser and full ALL evidence. API155 has no enclosed result; Web144 predates Web152. Existing primary-protocol, security, performance, TQA, cutover, final-review and CP6 gates remain open.

findings.title: The new unmount regression does not establish that the obsolete application continuation completed
findings.rationale: The recorded 111D04 repair requires the held-response navigation case to prove that the obsolete composer issues no follow-up GET. The new case awaits Playwright's deliveredOldResponse.body() and then an unrelated browser timer before asserting oldReplyOptionReads === 0. These establish network-body availability and a browser task, but do not establish that api.ts consumed response.text() and resumed the awaiting parent/composer continuation. The zero-read assertion can therefore run before the continuation it must test. The enclosed channel-transport cases explicitly instrument application response-body consumption for this ordering. This is a static protection-harness gap in the changed test; the mounted/ticket source correction itself is supported.
findings.suggested_action: Instrument consumption of the exact held A start-options response using the existing response.text completion-barrier pattern. Await a browser task scheduled from that consumption before checking zero obsolete reply-options GETs, zero message POSTs and unchanged B state. Preserve the actual response hashes and finally cleanup, then execute the native case and complete suite.
